// CASE inorder_alias_nested_brace expect=pass
type InOrderOptions = { signal?: { aborted: boolean }; reason: string };
export async function inOrder<T>(
  items: Iterable<T>,
  step: (item: T) => Promise<void>,
  options: InOrderOptions,
): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}
